L100001083017.text: The possible-updates sheet has a row from Dan O'Beirne (June 2025) saying the Uniper web page for the Ingolstadt plant gives net output, while the document linked at the bottom of that page gives a higher nameplate figure. GEM records nameplate generating capacity. Check the capacity of Unit 3 and Unit 4 against the Uniper document and the Bundesnetzagentur power plant list. Report Capacity (MW) only if the nameplate figure differs from the GEM value; otherwise say in a question what each source gives.
